# Return by 941 Apps

> A minimal, zen-like meditation timer for iPhone, Apple Watch, Mac, and Apple TV. No subscriptions, no guided content — just a beautiful timer for people who know how to meditate.

For comprehensive information, see: [llms-full.txt](https://941return.com/llms-full.txt)

## About

Return is a deliberately minimal meditation timer. Set your interval, choose an ambient theme, and sit — no streaks to maintain, no social feed, no subscription, and no guided narration. It is built for experienced practitioners who want a clean, calm timer rather than a content library. Available on iPhone, Apple Watch, Mac, and Apple TV.

## Key Features

- Clean interval timer with optional interval and ending bells
- Ambient themes for a calm, focused session
- Session tracking and history across Apple devices
- Apple Watch, Mac, and Apple TV apps alongside iPhone
- No subscriptions, no ads, no guided content

## App Details

- Platforms: iOS, watchOS, macOS, tvOS
- Developer: 941 Apps
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/return/id6756242021
